query: How can one report instances of caste discrimination?
reference_answer:
Reporting Casteist Discrimination:
Report casteist discrimination to the nearest police station or the District Social Welfare Officer. You can also contact the Tamil Nadu State Commission for SC/ST (Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes) for assistance.
answer: One can report instances of caste discrimination by contacting local human rights organizations, filing complaints with the police, or using online platforms like the Caste Discrimination Helpline. [Document 1]
